_: Gold set for tuning the distill prompt. Every slice is invented: no real conversation is in this file. Each chunk is a slice of turns; gold lists the (turn, outcome) pairs the model must produce and forbid lists outcomes that must NOT appear anywhere in the chunk. A proposal that is answered inside the slice needs no proposed item: the answer carries it. who is derived from the turn role by the validator. Run: node scripts/eval-prompt.js [--prompt file] [--model tag]
